thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT: Observability ingestion degraded (Datadog). Multiple dashboards showing stalled datapoints and traces delayed across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Alerts firing: high error-rate, missing APM traces, logs lag > 10m.

alex: paging @maya and @ravi — oncall? can you confirm scope?

maya: oncall here. I see traces queueing in Datadog intake, ingestion lag metric spiked ~10:05 UTC. Dashboards blanked for several services.

ravi: I’m pulling the Datadog status page and our ingest metrics. datadog status shows partial ingestion degradation in events/ingest for those regions.

sre-bot: Escalation policy: page level-2 oncall after 5m. Current oncall: maya (primary), alex (backup).

sam: quick customer-impact check: are production requests failing, or is it just observability? App metrics still show normal throughput (via infra metrics), but error budgets can't be validated. Some internal alerts depend on DD-derived SLOs and are noisy.

maya: confirmed — app traffic healthy per host metrics from our Prometheus/CloudWatch. This is a blindspot: no APM spans, traces delayed, real-time dashboards stale. Customers relying on our incident page for metrics will see gaps.

jess: tagging CS & Support. support-bot, can you compile a list of customers with active incident subscriptions that might be impacted?

support-bot: Noted. Pulling customers with active alerting hooks to Datadog webhooks. Found 12 active customers with webhook-based routing, 3 enterprise customers with on-prem monitoring connectors.

ravi: mitigation plan: 1) open Datadog support ticket (done, case #DD-87622). 2) fallback to CloudWatch/Prometheus dashboards for critical signals. 3) suppress noisy DD-based alerts and open synthetic checks against ingestion fallbacks. 4) capture local debug logs for request traces for the next 60m.

alex: please execute fallbacks now. Maya/ravi take the lead. I’ll own comms + status page.

maya: running commands to enable fallback dashboards and rewire SRE routing for critical alerts. snippet:```bash
# temporarily use CloudWatch metrics for latency SLO
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace "Redwood/Runtime" --metric-name request_latency_p95 --start-time $(date -u -d '5 minutes ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --end-time $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --period 60 --statistics Maximum
```

ravi: disabling the following Datadog alert rules that are firing noise: dd-err-rate-prod, dd-apm-lag-prod. Replacing with alert rules pointing to `prometheus/redwood_request_errors` and `cloudwatch/request_latency_p95`.

sam: FYI we should not acknowledge customer-facing incidents unless user-impact confirmed. I recommend writing to affected customers with a brief 'observability degraded' update and note we are investigating — avoid saying 'Datadog' is root cause until confirmed.

alex: agreed. Draft status update for status.redwood.ai: "We are seeing delays delivering observability data (metrics, traces) in some regions. Application traffic continues; we are investigating and using fallback metrics"

jess: preparing customer outreach for 3 enterprise customers and top 5 accounts. Will coordinate with account owners for any tailored comms.

ravi: Datadog replied: "We've identified an ingestion pipeline delay affecting select regions; working on backfill. No action required from your side yet." They've provided a temporary ETA of 30-45m for stabilization.

maya: starting local trace dumps on a subset of nodes to retain span details. Command:```bash
kubectl -n runtime exec -it deploy/runtime-collector -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS localhost:9200/debug/dump-spans > /tmp/spans-$(hostname)-$(date +%s).json"
```

sre-bot: Reminder: create post-incident ticket with timeline, DD case link, and mitigation actions.

alex: handoff plan — maya will stay for next 45m to monitor ingestion metrics, then hand to ravi for the overnight watch. If Datadog ETA slips > 60m, escalate to infra lead and consider turning on extended local retention.

maya: acknowledged. I'll run 15m checks and update thread. Current impact: observability blindspot (severity: P2), customer visible data gaps for 12 customers' dashboards, no direct request failures reported.

ravi: adding runbook snippet to the incident ticket for future: "If third-party ingest outage, switch primary alarms to internal metrics, capture local traces, inform CS, suppress DD-derived alerts."

support-bot: Support task created: SUP-33421 — notify listed customers, attach suggested wording.

alex: uploaded status update to status.redwood.ai and pinged legal for any contract churn risk flags.

maya: Datadog reports beginning to backfill now (ingestion backlog decreasing). Monitoring dashboards showing traces reappearing. Will keep watching for 30m to ensure backfill completes.

jess: prepping postmortem template and stakeholders list.

ravi: if anything changes, ping with @here and escalate. Otherwise we'll close when backfill completes and no regression in alerts for 1 hour.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Datadog reports partial remediation; observability ingestion backlog decreasing. Case #DD-87622.

alex: thanks everyone. Handoff to ravi at 18:30 UTC. Final note: this reinforced need to expand fallback dashboards—I'll open an RFC for permanent routes within Optimize.
